Исполнитель: implementation/high. Порядок: e2e (падает) → роль и каталог → схема → стадия → сохранение → V1.
Образец read-only роли: packages/orch/roles/context-scout.json (читать самому: в reads его нельзя — manifest содержит служебные поля, которые brief отклоняет).

result.notes: Nothing was changed. The researcher role cannot be added inside scope.write_set: a new conductor schema needs a KINDS entry in lib/orch/conductor/contract.py (registry() fails on any mismatch between schema files and KINDS), role-manifest.result_shape is a closed enum without research-result (schemas/exec/v1/role-manifest.schema.json), and the plan rule on closed schemas requires valid/invalid fixtures (packages/orch/fixtures/conductor/v1/*/research-result) and a docs/contracts.md line. All of these are outside the write set.
result.escalation: Write set is insufficient: need packages/orch/lib/orch/conductor/contract.py (KINDS), packages/orch/schemas/exec/v1/role-manifest.schema.json (result_shape enum + aicore schema compat), packages/orch/fixtures/conductor/v1/valid|invalid/research-result/*, packages/orch/docs/contracts.md. Optionally lib/orch/conductor/heal.py (heal rule for research-result).
